name: Reza Clifton
body: When my dad died, I was pretty much manic doing the work of putting photographs together because there were so many! When Paul did the sound at his memorial service, I remember it was the first time I finally felt calm and able to process things. I knew we were in good hands under Paul handling those aspects of the event and knowing I could finally release my duties and emote. Paul never forgot my role as a member and leader in the local cultural community and as a DJ/selecta for years, always giving me shout-outs and recognizing me as an Empress when I walked into Parlour. This is who he was. Who he never stopped being. Who he will always be in the hearts of many. He was so special to so many people and just like so many of you, me and my family are devastated by his passing. I am sending love to all who loved him and all he loved.
